intro: The Intrepid Strongbox Key is a rusted iron key once guarded jealously by Captain Halyndor, commander of the doomed Alliance vessel Intrepid. Even in undeath, the captain clutches it, keeping locked away the cursed artifact that brought ruin to his crew off the coast of the Wetlands.

p: During the wreck of the Third Fleet off the stormy shores of the Wetlands, the warship Intrepid was cast into ruin, its crew twisted into restless, cursed spirits. Captain Halyndor obsessively watched over a mysterious item stowed inside the vessel's heavy strongbox. In death, his spectral figure continues to prowl the waterlogged deck, refusing to relinquish the rusted key that unlocks the hold's deepest, darkest cargo.
